categories.main_business_segments: Qingdao Huicheng Environmental Technology Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in waste resource comprehensive utilization, hazardous waste treatment and disposal services, and industrial waste gas treatment. The company focuses on solid waste catalyst recycling, high-sulfur petroleum coke hydrogen production ash residue utilization, industrial waste gas non-ammonia reduction denitrification, and deep catalytic cracking of mixed waste plastics. It also engages in three-waste (solid, liquid, gas) pollution control and related environmental protection services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company relies on proprietary technologies including solid waste catalyst resource utilization, high-sulfur petroleum coke hydrogen ash comprehensive utilization, industrial waste gas non-ammonia reduction denitrification, chemical recycling of industrial waste sulfuric acid, saline wastewater reuse, and deep catalytic cracking of mixed waste plastics. It employs fluid catalytic cracking (FCC) catalyst production, molecular sieve synthesis, and advanced chemical recycling methods. The company emphasizes innovation in green technology and circular economy processes, with multiple patents supporting its production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic refining enterprises, especially in Shandong province, and major petrochemical companies such as China Petroleum & Chemical Corporation (Guangdong Petrochemical). The company serves the petroleum refining, chemical manufacturing, and environmental protection sectors. It is expanding into international markets and targeting state-owned enterprises and overseas clients for catalyst and additive products. The waste plastic recycling business also targets municipal solid waste and agricultural film recycling sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with significant facilities and projects in Shandong Province (Qingdao, Dongjiakou), Guangdong Province (Jieyang), Jiangxi Province (Ruichang), and other regions including Gansu, Hunan, and Xinjiang. It also has a subsidiary in the United States (Forland Petrochemical Technology LLC). The company is actively expanding its market presence beyond domestic borders to international customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qingdao Huicheng operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental technology and chemical catalyst supply chain. It processes and recycles industrial solid wastes, produces and sells catalysts and additives, and provides hazardous waste treatment services. The company integrates waste treatment with resource recovery and product sales, forming a closed-loop circular economy model.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in green and circular technologies, focusing on breakthroughs in waste catalyst recycling, industrial waste gas treatment, and chemical recycling of plastics. It invests heavily in R&D for new catalyst formulations, process optimization, and resource recovery technologies. Key R&D projects include high-purity vanadium extraction from slag, mixed waste plastic catalytic cracking, and industrial waste sulfuric acid recycling. The company also emphasizes talent development and management system modernization to support rapid growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of resource utilization products (catalysts, additives, recycled materials), hazardous waste treatment and disposal service fees, and environmental remediation projects. The company operates on a direct sales model with major customers, including long-term contracts with petrochemical enterprises. It also receives government subsidies and grants related to environmental protection initiatives.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a competitive position in the domestic environmental technology and chemical catalyst market, particularly in solid waste catalyst recycling and high-sulfur petroleum coke ash utilization. It faces intense competition in the catalyst industry, with pressure on prices and profit margins. Qingdao Huicheng differentiates itself through proprietary technologies, stable customer relationships, and pioneering projects such as the first domestic high-sulfur petroleum coke hydrogen ash comprehensive utilization facility. It is expanding internationally to mitigate domestic market challenges.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.15 billion, a 7.33% increase over 2023, but net profit attributable to shareholders declined by 69.24% to RMB 42.6 million due to increased costs and price pressures. Total assets grew by over 50% to nearly RMB 4.94 billion, reflecting significant investment in new projects. The company’s R&D expenditure increased by nearly 24%, supporting its innovation-driven growth strategy. Despite profitability challenges, the company is expanding capacity and investing in new business lines.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Qingdao Huicheng emphasizes its unique value proposition of 'original technology innovation and resource recovery from waste,' offering advanced, environmentally friendly solutions that go beyond traditional landfill and incineration methods. Its proprietary technologies enable efficient resource recycling, pollution reduction, and circular economy integration, providing customers with sustainable waste treatment and high-value recycled products. The company’s integrated business model combining waste disposal, resource recovery, and product sales creates synergistic benefits and competitive advantages.
